# Eksotika Prima

> Supplier of minyak gosok (traditional Indonesian rub/massage oils). Retail, wholesale, and international shipping.

Eksotika Prima is one of Indonesia's largest suppliers of minyak gosok, minyak urut, and minyak pijat (traditional Indonesian rub, massage, and herbal body-care oils). We serve personal customers, shops, resellers, and wholesale buyers, with support for international shipping.

Canonical URL: https://eksotikaprima.com

## Key sections

- [Products](https://eksotikaprima.com/product): Full catalog of massage and rub oils with variants and sizes.
- [News](https://eksotikaprima.com/news): Product information, tips, and updates.
- [Contact](https://eksotikaprima.com/contact): Address, phone, WhatsApp, and marketplace stores.
